what.title: Built on Self Recovery
what.subtitle: Alignment Begins with Movement
body: SNPE (Self Natural Posture Exercise) is a self-directed movement recovery system designed to help restore the body's natural alignment and movement.

It is not simply an exercise that strengthens muscles or repeatedly uses a specific body part. It is an integrated movement system designed to help people recognize and restore balance disrupted by poor posture habits and movement patterns.

SNPE began with a spine-centered concept of posture recovery, but it has evolved into a more integrated and scientific movement system that connects the feet, pelvis, breathing, kinetic chain, and everyday movement habits.

beginning.title: SNPE began with the question of recurring chronic lower back pain
body: SNPE was born from years of research and clinical experience addressing recurring spinal imbalances and movement dysfunction.
The early philosophy of SNPE started with the question: "Is movement that allows people to recover on their own, without depending on someone else, possible?"

The founder of SNPE, the late Professor Choi Jung-ki, experienced recurring lower back pain and movement limitations, and studied the principles of body alignment and movement recovery for many years. Based on chiropractic, exercise therapy, posture correction theory, and movement observation, SNPE developed into a self-directed movement system.
note: SNPE was especially inspired by the way teeth gradually align over time. It was designed so that repeated, correct movement learning can help restore body alignment and movement balance. This is one of SNPE's core ideas: sustainable movement habits and sensory awareness matter more than momentary correction.
To help restore stiff and restricted deep muscles and movement patterns more gently, SNPE also developed its own exercise tools inspired by finger pressure and biomechanical principles.
beginning.quote:
"Alignment is not forced.
It is restored through repeated correct movement."

expanding.title: Expanding into movement-based wellness
body: Today, SNPE goes beyond posture correction or musculoskeletal pain management. It is expanding into a movement system that views life balance and wellness through the recovery of body alignment and movement.

SNPE takes an integrated view of chronic pain, discomfort, tension, and movement limitations caused by repeated lifestyle habits and movement patterns, and values more natural and sustainable movement recovery.

Beyond body alignment and movement function, SNPE connects breathing and nervous system recovery, body balance and shape management, embodied awareness and self-efficacy, and wellness from the perspectives of healthy aging and longevity.

From growing children to adults and seniors, SNPE aims to be a sustainable movement system that helps people of many ages and lifestyles understand their bodies and restore movement balance on their own.

future.title: Researching the future of movement
body: SNPE is developing beyond a simple exercise program into an integrated movement system that studies human movement and life balance.
In an era of rapid AI and digital technology, SNPE is building a more precise and personalized movement environment based on movement data and evaluation systems.
SNPE also connects movement science, wellness, and digital healthcare technology to better understand each person's movement characteristics and recovery process.
Going forward, SNPE aims to connect AI-based movement analysis with a global education system and grow into a global movement brand that helps people sustain healthy movement in daily life.

missionVision.title: The direction SNPE pursues
missionVision.missionTitle: Helping people recover their bodies on their own
missionBody: Modern life, including long hours of sitting, smartphone and computer use, lack of exercise, and aging, causes many people to lose physical balance.
Through science-based exercise methods, tools, and education systems, SNPE helps people restore correct posture and healthy movement, and regain lost physical function and balance.
Our mission is to awaken the self-recovery ability that humans naturally possess and present a way for anyone to live a healthy and beautiful life.
missionVision.visionTitle:
A Global Human Recovery Brand
leading a culture of self-recovery
visionBody: SNPE goes beyond providing exercise methods and tools. It builds a culture of self-recovery in which anyone can understand their body and manage their health independently.

Through scientific research, education, and innovative solutions, we aim to help restore natural human health and balance, and grow into a global Human Recovery Brand that creates healthier individuals, communities, and society.
Contributing to healthy and beautiful lives around the world is the future SNPE pursues.

beginnerGuidePage.title: SNPE Guide for Beginners
beginnerGuidePage.intro: You do not have to start with anything difficult. SNPE is a process of understanding your body's condition and learning correct movement step by step. Follow these five steps to check your posture and movement habits and begin healthy body balance.

1.title: Learn About SNPE
1.desc: Understand how SNPE manages movement and postural balance. From recurring discomfort in the neck, back, and pelvis to body imbalance, bow legs, forward head posture, and posture habits, learn why body alignment and movement patterns matter.

2.title: Self Body Analysis
2.desc: Use the SNPE app and self-checks to understand your current body shape and movement condition. Check shoulder height difference, pelvic balance, leg alignment, and posture habits to understand the movement direction you need.

3.title: Learn Basic Movements
3.desc: Learn SNPE basic belt exercises and tool MOVE movements while building a sense of correct body alignment. Experience the principles of movement starting from the feet, how to use SNPE tools, basic posture, and the connection between breathing and movement.

4.title: Follow Exercise Videos
4.desc: Practice movement repeatedly with exercise videos. Even short routines can gradually change movement patterns and posture habits when repeated consistently. Use home training, recovery routines, and body-area programs in ways that fit your lifestyle.

5.title: Visit a Professional Center
5.desc: If you need more systematic care, receive professional guidance at an SNPE center. Experienced center directors and officially certified instructors suggest personalized programs based on body evaluation and movement analysis. Through private lessons or small group lessons, you can experience more accurate movement and body balance.

intro.title: Your Body is Built to Heal Itself
intro.subtitle:
SNPE focuses on understanding your body's movement
and repeatedly learning correct movement patterns.
intro.lead: The core philosophy of SNPE begins with the belief that the body naturally has a direction toward restoring balance on its own.
intro.body: Based on the principles of selection, concentration, and repetition, SNPE pursues a more natural and sustainable recovery of movement. Rather than focusing only on momentary change, SNPE places greater value on helping the body understand and practice movement principles and build correct posture habits.

meaning.title: Movement for Natural Posture Restoration
meaning.body: The name SNPE stands for Self · Natural · Posture · Exercise, and is based on a philosophy that pursues recovery of natural human movement.

items.body: SNPE uses NP (Natural Posture), the natural alignment state the human body should have, as the standard for all movement. Correct alignment is not simply about fixing posture. It becomes the starting point where each joint and muscle can function most efficiently. Rather than forcing a specific posture, SNPE focuses on restoring the body's natural movement patterns so the body can find balanced alignment on its own.
items.quote: Natural Posture is not forced. It is restored through movement.

items.body: Poor posture and repeated daily habits stiffen muscles and fascia, limiting range of movement. SNPE begins by gently releasing a tense and stiff body. By using bands, belts, and tool systems, it helps ease tension in body tissues and restore the joints' natural range of motion. Through recognizing and resolving left-right imbalance, SNPE creates an environment where the body can choose more natural and stable movement.

Once movement becomes freer, the body needs a strong center to support that movement stably. In SNPE, the core is not simply abdominal muscle strength. It means central stability that connects the whole body. By activating deep muscles, SNPE helps force transfer efficiently on correct alignment and relearns step by step so the center and limbs can coordinate organically.

items.local: Correct movement is completed through repetition
items.body: The body is influenced more by postures repeated throughout daily life than by one hour of exercise. Just as incorrect movement becomes fixed through repetition, correct movement must also be learned by the body through practice and repetition in everyday life. SNPE sees daily movements such as walking, sitting, standing, and breathing as the core of change. Sustainable recovery through continuous observation and improvement of one's body is the ultimate value SNPE pursues.

philosophyPage.closing: Recovery through movement. This is the philosophy of SNPE.

introBody: The SNPE Official Program is SNPE’s official education and movement system, built on scientific assessment and standardized exercise protocols. At SNPE professional centers, the SNPE posture assessment protocol is used to accurately evaluate each member’s body type and movement, then provide the most suitable program based on lifestyle analysis, personal goals, and current condition.

The program consists of four categories—START, RECOVERY, BODY LINE, and CONDITIONING—with a total of 10 official programs. From foundations and recovery to body-line improvement and conditioning, you can experience a Self Recovery System that builds a healthier body step by step.

programs.name: SNPE Basic
programs.target: Those starting SNPE for the first time, beginners, or anyone who wants to learn the basics of healthy posture
programs.effect: Build a foundation for understanding SNPE’s core principles and restoring body alignment. Learning correct movement early helps maximize the benefits of later programs.

programs.name: Neck & Shoulder Recovery
programs.target: Those with neck pain, stiff shoulders, forward head posture, or rounded shoulders
programs.effect: Gently release tense neck and shoulder muscles and restore healthy upper-body alignment. Reduce everyday stiffness and create more comfortable movement.

programs.name: Low Back & Pelvis Recovery
programs.target: Those with low-back pain, pelvic imbalance, or long hours of sitting
programs.effect: Restore balance in the pelvis and lower back to reduce strain and build stable posture. Also helpful for preventing recurring low-back discomfort.

programs.name: Foot & Lower Body Recovery
programs.target: Those whose feet tire easily, who stand for long periods, or who want better lower-body circulation and posture
programs.effect: Restore foot arch function to support comfortable walking, and realign the lower body to strengthen whole-body posture foundations.

programs.name: Face & Shoulder Line
programs.target: Those concerned about facial asymmetry, rounded shoulders, or upper-body line
programs.effect: Realign the neck and shoulders to refine the face line and create a slimmer shoulder line. Improve circulation around the face and shoulders to reduce puffiness and refresh your appearance.

programs.name: Waist & Pelvic Line
programs.target: Those who want to improve waist and pelvic line
programs.effect: Activate the core and restore pelvic alignment to create a slim, firm waist line. Balance left-right body asymmetry for a natural, stable body line.

programs.name: Leg Line
programs.target: Those concerned about bow legs, knock knees, or lower-body swelling
programs.effect: Improve lower-body alignment and circulation for balanced leg lines and lighter legs. Distribute load more evenly across the legs to improve gait and walking balance.

programs.name: SNPE Flow
programs.target: Those who want to move joyfully while building flexibility and stamina together
programs.effect: Rhythmic whole-body movement improves flexibility, balance, and cardiorespiratory endurance for a more energetic body. Enjoyable movement also helps relieve stress and build positive exercise habits.

programs.name: SNPE Fit
programs.target: Those who want solid strength and a balanced body line
programs.effect: Strengthen whole-body muscles to build a balanced body and firm body line. Raising basal metabolism supports healthier body-shape management without rebound.

programs.name: Body Release
programs.target: Those who feel fatigued or heavy in the body
programs.effect: Gently release whole-body tension and promote circulation to ease fatigue and restore a comfortable condition. Better sleep and recovery also support the next day’s condition.
